"import csv
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches


def main():
    # Read CSV data
    data = []
    with open('perf_04.csv', 'r', newline='') as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f)
        for row in reader:
            data.append({
                'config': row['config'].strip(),
                'cl_max': float(row['cl_max']),
                'cd_cruise': float(row['cd_cruise']),
                'ld_ratio': float(row['ld_ratio']),
            })

    # Compute statistics from the CSV values
    cl_max_vals = [d['cl_max'] for d in data]
    cd_cruise_vals = [d['cd_cruise'] for d in data]
    ld_ratio_vals = [d['ld_ratio'] for d in data]

    cl_max_max = max(cl_max_vals)
    cd_cruise_mean = sum(cd_cruise_vals) / len(cd_cruise_vals)
    ld_ratio_mean = sum(ld_ratio_vals) / len(ld_ratio_vals)

    # Best config = argmax over L/D ratio
    best_idx = max(range(len(ld_ratio_vals)), key=lambda i: ld_ratio_vals[i])
    best_config = data[best_idx]['config']

    # Rounded display values (exactly as required)
    cl_max_disp = round(cl_max_max, 3)       # 0.613
    cd_cruise_disp = round(cd_cruise_mean, 4)  # 0.0333
    ld_ratio_disp = round(ld_ratio_mean, 1)  # 17.1

    # Build presentation
    prs = Presentation()

    # ---- Slide 1: Title ----
    slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
    slide1.shapes.title.text = "Engineering Test Briefing"
    slide1.placeholders[1].text = "Performance Data Analysis"

    # ---- Slide 2: Data (one table) ----
    slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])  # Title Only
    slide2.shapes.title.text = "Data"

    n_rows = len(data) + 1
    n_cols = 4
    left = Inches(0.5)
    top = Inches(1.4)
    width = Inches(8.5)
    height = Inches(0.35 * n_rows + 0.2)
    table_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(n_rows, n_cols, left, top, width, height)
    table = table_shape.table

    headers = ['config', 'cl_max', 'cd_cruise', 'ld_ratio']
    for j, h in enumerate(headers):
        table.cell(0, j).text = h

    for i, row in enumerate(data, start=1):
        table.cell(i, 0).text = str(row['config'])
        table.cell(i, 1).text = str(row['cl_max'])
        table.cell(i, 2).text = str(row['cd_cruise'])
        table.cell(i, 3).text = str(row['ld_ratio'])

    # ---- Slide 3: Summary (bullet lines with exact numbers) ----
    slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])  # Title and Content
    slide3.shapes.title.text = "Summary"

    tf = slide3.placeholders[1].text_frame
    tf.text = f"CLmax max = {cl_max_disp}"
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = f"CDcruise mean = {cd_cruise_disp}"
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = f"L/D mean = {ld_ratio_disp}"
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = f"best config (max L/D) = {best_config}"

    # ---- Slide 4: Next steps ----
    slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
    slide4.shapes.title.text = "Next Steps"

    tf4 = slide4.placeholders[1].text_frame
    tf4.text = "Validate measured performance against CFD predictions."
    p = tf4.add_paragraph()
    p.text = f"Investigate configuration {best_config} in further wind-tunnel tests."
    p = tf4.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Plan additional runs to refine CLmax and CDcruise estimates."

    prs.save('report.pptx')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()"
